title: AutoLee device state
description: Payload of GET /api/state and of the default (state) SSE event on /events.

defaultPassword.description: True while the web/API password is still the factory default ("autolee"). While true, the firmware refuses every state-changing write except POST /api/v1/system/web_password with 403 - set a real password to clear this.

positionStale.description: Calibration was restored across a reboot but the axis has not been re-referenced against the UP hard stop since. The device refuses to start a run while this is true; a Return Home (or a fresh calibration) clears it.

sg.description: StallGuard trip; a jam is SG_RESULT above it. 0 means not set, and the press refuses to run until every profile has one (see sgSetUp).

floor.description: The trip sits at the SG floor (Auto SG read only 0/1 at this speed). Detection then relies on a stall spiking off the floor and is limited; block-test the profile.

wifiHostname.description: mDNS name the device advertises, e.g. "autolee.local". Empty string when it advertises none - on the setup AP, or if mDNS failed to start. Always present, never null. A convenience on top of wifiIP and never a replacement: mDNS does not resolve everywhere, so wifiIP stays the address of record.

sgSetUp.description: Every profile has a StallGuard trip. While false the device refuses to start a run (409 jam_detection_not_set_up); POST /api/v1/motion/auto_sg sets them.

sgCalCurrentMa.description: Run current Auto SG last measured at, in mA. 0 if it never ran. Trips hold only at this current.

autoSgActive.description: Auto SG is measuring; jam detection is off for this run.

autoSgStroke.description: Measured strokes so far on that profile.

autoSgStrokes.description: Strokes Auto SG measures per profile.
